title: No Crystals & Anchors
description: This datapack removes End Crystals and Respawn Achors recipes
body:
# No More Crystals or Anchors

This lightweight datapack disables the crafting recipes for both **End Crystals** and **Respawn Anchors**. It is perfect for multiplayer servers or SMPs where you want to prevent explosive PvP tactics, griefing, or accidental base destruction. Once installed, these two items are completely uncraftable in survival mode.

## 🎯 Purpose & Appeal
In modern Minecraft multiplayer, Crystal PvP and Respawn Anchor explosions have dominated combat, often making traditional armor and weapons obsolete. Additionally, these items are frequently used for fast and unblockable griefing. 

By installing this datapack, you can restore classic Minecraft combat, protect your server's economy, and keep player bases safe from instant destruction.

## ✨ Features
* **No Respawn Anchor Recipe:** Completely removes the crafting recipe for the Respawn Anchor from the game.
* **No End Crystal Recipe:** Completely disables the crafting grid recipe for the End Crystal.
* **Clean & Lightweight:** No lag, no custom commands, and zero impact on server performance.
